name: Campus Notes - forget me not.
source:
"Campus Notes - Forget Me Not." is a visual novel set in the University of Tsukuba, created by 4th cluster, an indie game studio established from the same university.
The University of Tsukuba is a National university that is the focus of Tsukuba Science City, a town 50km east of Tokyo. The city has a unique culture, as the area is heavily populated by students.
The story is placed in true-to-life settings of Tsukuba city. Come and enjoy a slice of campus life. Meet our heroes and heroines and set out on a strange adventure, and maybe even fall in love...

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/435360/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《校园笔记——勿忘我》是一部以筑波大学为背景的视觉小说，由同一大学成立的独立游戏工作室4th cluster创作。
筑波大学是一所国立大学，是东京以东50公里处的筑波科学城的中心。这座城市拥有独特的文化，因为该地区学生众多。
故事发生在筑波市的真实生活场景中。快来享受校园生活吧。认识我们的男女主角，开始一场奇怪的冒险，甚至可能坠入爱河……

[来自[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/435360/]Steam[/url]]
